description: Our team is driven by our passion for data and environmental science. Through our project we aim to create a tangible way to visualise, express and gauge weather and environmental patterns in order to develop our understanding of the world.
summary: Our project aimed to be an intuitive way to visualise complex weather data and create a fun way for users to view Japan. We chose Japan as it a diverse, interesting region that would be enjoyable to research.  It also had a variety of data available across multiple sources many other teams would not consider using. Ultimately, our project served with the goal to identity relationships between existing data, validate its significance and produce a realistic projection of future possibilities.
details: Our project used a variety of data from NASA and other sources to map data in a way that is visually easy to infer and understand. It allows us to also predict future events and see the significance of data. AI tools such as Claude were used to assist in the development of our on site bot, Zen. We used HTML, CSS and JavaScript primarily with the help of SI for some of the code. Our project is unlike others as it features an interactive globe, adjustable sliders and an interactive map.
